title: Fix 3 buggy functions in rust_num_parser
description: Brownfield Rust dirty scenario: parse_int, parse_pair, and parse_and_sum each have a bug. Fix them so all 3 tests pass.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix the 3 bugs in src/lib.rs so all 3 tests pass.

  fn parse_int(s: &str) -> i32
    — missing .trim() causes panic on whitespace-padded strings
    — fix: change s.parse() to s.trim().parse()

  fn parse_pair(s: &str) -> (i32, i32)
    — returns (b, a) instead of (a, b)
    — fix: return (a, b)

  fn parse_and_sum(s: &str) -> i32
    — subtracts (a - b) instead of adding
    — fix: return a + b

Do not modify the test code.
Run: cargo test
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `cargo test` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
